entry.title: Degraded: API — Slow admission and intermittent timeouts
entry.content:
API · Degraded · 2026-09-13 11:45–12:53 UTC · 1 h 8 min

A monthly budget check summed a whole month of usage under the same organization row lock; admission queued fleet-wide (checker saw 35–54 s and one timeout) until the budget row was removed, and the check was rewritten to read maintained rollups the same day.

https://status.experientiallabs.ai/

entry.title: Degraded: API — Requests waited 1.5–2.5 minutes before admission
entry.content:
API · Degraded · 2026-09-12 18:01–19:05 UTC · 1 h 4 min

One high-volume organization's per-request rate-window check scanned its whole day of usage under a row lock; queued reservations held every worker's admission permits, so all requests waited 90–145 s and some were refused with a location error after the edge location stamp expired. Fixed the same evening by moving the windows to maintained counters.

https://status.experientiallabs.ai/

entry.title: Outage: API — Gateway unavailable while the new build warmed its catalog
entry.content:
API · Outage · 2026-09-11 22:37–22:55 UTC · 18 min

The new build could not serve the stored catalog snapshot and returned 503 for about 16 minutes until the first publish completed; live traffic fell to zero requests in a 15-minute window.

entry.title: Degraded: API — Elevated errors after a database schema change landed before the fleet rolled
entry.content:
API · Degraded · 2026-09-11 22:14–22:37 UTC · 23 min

A billing-unit schema migration applied to production at merge while the previous build was still serving; control-plane routes returned 500 and about 20% of gateway requests failed until the new build rolled.

https://status.experientiallabs.ai/

entry.title: Outage: API — Edge returned 502 during a failed release
entry.content:
API · Outage · 2026-09-06 18:20–18:35 UTC · 15 min

A production release (18:04–18:26 UTC) failed and its rollback left the public edge returning 502; requests were not accepted for ~15 minutes until the previous revision was restored at 18:35.

https://status.experientiallabs.ai/

entry.title: Degraded: Web Dashboard — Slow signed-in pages
entry.summary: Web Dashboard · Degraded · 2026-09-06 06:50–10:50 UTC · 4 h 0 min
entry.content:
Web Dashboard · Degraded · 2026-09-06 06:50–10:50 UTC · 4 h 0 min

Under a signup surge (about 3k per hour), signed-in pages took 3–5 s and intermittently timed out: the grants table lacked an organization index (43.7M rows scanned per read) and the model list made five sequential reads per page. Index built at 10:02 UTC; the list was folded into one read in the same fix.

https://status.experientiallabs.ai/

entry.title: Degraded: API — Gateway workers restarting on memory pressure
entry.content:
API · Degraded · 2026-09-06 03:00–09:45 UTC · 6 h 45 min

A post-rebuild comparison introduced the previous evening ran after every catalog rebuild while connection changes triggered rebuilds about once a minute, so worker memory ratcheted to its 4 GiB limit and pods restarted repeatedly. About 5% of requests ended incomplete. Mitigated at 09:36 UTC by switching to lean catalog variants; restarts stopped by 09:50.

https://status.experientiallabs.ai/

entry.title: Degraded: API — Free-tier limit checks surfaced as internal errors
entry.content:
API · Degraded · 2026-09-05 05:20–06:20 UTC · 1 h 0 min

A schema change landed before the gateway worker that understood it, so free-tier exhaustion rejections raised an unmapped database error code and were reported as `internal` (~170/min, 30–50% of requests). Cleared when the updated worker rolled at 06:31 UTC; paid traffic was unaffected.

https://status.experientiallabs.ai/

entry.title: Outage: Web Dashboard — Dashboard down after a failed release rollback
entry.content:
Web Dashboard · Outage · 2026-09-05 04:57–05:30 UTC · 33 min

A production release failed at the gateway-worker step and its automatic rollback re-applied the web app with an empty environment group, so the dashboard returned errors. The environment was restored by hand at 05:30 UTC.

entry.title: Outage: API — Database restart
entry.content:
API · Outage · 2026-09-05 03:51–03:59 UTC · 8 min

Production Postgres shut down on an administrator command at 03:51 UTC and came back after crash recovery at 03:58:50. Gateway readiness gates on the database, so /v1 returned 503 and requests were not accepted for ~8 minutes.

entry.title: Outage: API — Requests hung during a large catalog publish
entry.content:
API · Outage · 2026-09-03 08:52–09:02 UTC · 10 min

A publish repointing 732 model aliases made every gateway pod rebuild its catalog inline on the request path; requests hung with no response for ~10 minutes (zero accepted requests at 08:53). Fix deployed 17:36 UTC: the request path now only hydrates an already-published snapshot.

https://status.experientiallabs.ai/

entry.title: Degraded: API — Elevated errors during repeated catalog publishes
entry.content:
API · Degraded · 2026-09-02 05:50–07:40 UTC · 1 h 50 min

Back-to-back catalog publishes forced gateway workers to rebuild routing state on the request path; requests landing on a rebuilding pod failed as `unavailable` (20–35% of requests). Recurred 10:40–12:50 UTC. Root cause fixed the next day (request path no longer rebuilds the catalog).
